messages:
jamie_recruiter: FYI 1 Senior Product Ops candidate (Ravi P.) onsite Thu 2026-09-02 10:30-15:30 PT. Candidate requested low-sensory room, written prompts for case study, and a transit stipend. Need badge, loaner laptop, lunch voucher, and parking validation.
priya: Transit stipend approved $30 (OPS-TRN-2026). Recruiter DM payout details or candidate can submit receipt after. Lunch voucher up to $20, GF and vegetarian noted.
ellie_ops: Booking Quiet Room D 10:00-16:00 for buffers; low lighting and no wall art. Reception will greet quietly and provide temporary badge (bring ID). Parking validated at Lot C code 22-07.
it_support: We have a sanitized loaner (Ubuntu) available. Will disable camera and provide offline editor for the written case. Guest account pre-created; ready by 10:00.
peopleops_bot: Checklist created: Quiet Room D, loaner reserve, badge, parking code, lunch voucher, calendar invite (ID 1987654321-RAVI), reminders 24h/30m.
jamie_recruiter: Candidate prefers a typed-only case study (no live coding or whiteboard). Hiring manager Nate please send written prompt 48h before.
nate_pm: Will send the written prompt by Tue EOD and keep the case to 30 minutes plus 10 min buffer for notes.
priya: Accessibility note 1 candidate uses a small wearable support device  allowed. Front desk to provide a private locker and outlet near desk.
ellie_ops: Noted  Reception will use quiet greeting, no photos, and provide headphones if requested.
candidate_portal: Packet reminder sent: upload ID and signed NDA here: https://portal.redwood.example/upload (deadline 48h before).
jamie_recruiter: Can we pre-pay transit stipend via ACH today? I'll DM details. Also need on-site contact for day-of issues.
priya: Yes send DM. Expense code OPS-TRN-2026. Payout processed same day if details provided.
ellie_ops: Day-of ops contact posted to panel channel once confirmed. We'll also leave printed direction to Quiet Room D at Reception.
it_support: Note to panelists  loaner will be offline and camera-disabled; please do not request recordings. We'll test environment at 10:00.
peopleops_bot: Reminder scheduled: send arrival instructions to candidate 24h before loop.
jamie_recruiter: Great, thanks everyone. I'll confirm ETA tomorrow and post stipend confirmation once DM sent. :thumbsup:
